title: The bell opens the inbox and badges the unread count
custom_preconds:
1. Sign in as an Owner/Admin user (on a QA branch: the Admin quick-login button on the sign-in page; you appear as "Admin ShopView"). The Notifications page opens from the bell icon at the top right, next to your location name.
  2. Seed 3 notifications addressed to you: a second user writes the notes (on a QA branch the second user is the Tech quick-login user (sign in from a private browser window with the Tech button; appears as "Tech ShopView")): open a work order (top menu Work Orders -> click a work order number (e.g. S2-4219) -> Notes tab) -> New Note, type a message, type @ and pick "Admin ShopView" (or click a tag group pill you belong to under "Tag groups:"), then click Save. Also reach the states of 0, exactly 99, and 100+ unread (seed enough notes, or mark some read).
custom_steps:
1. Read the bell icon in the top navigation and its badge.
  2. Click the bell and confirm it opens the Notifications inbox.
  3. Compare the badge to your unread count at 7 unread, at 99, at 100, and at 0.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • A bell icon in the top navigation opens the Notifications inbox.
  • The bell shows a badge with the count of your unread notifications - the exact number up to 99, and "99+" for 100 or more.
  • When the count is zero, no badge is shown.

Source - where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-9667 (Founder Mode Batch #1); story SV-10244 (S1, Work the Notifications inbox); Notifications Update v1 PRD (Confluence 817463297), S1; design boards InboxAfter/Main; read 30 Sep 2026. Source-verified 30 September 2026.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S1-R1: “A bell icon in the top navigation opens the Notifications inbox.”
  • S1-R2: “The bell shows a badge with the count of the user's unread notifications.”
  • S1-R3: “The badge shows the exact count up to 99, and "99+" for 100 or more.”
  • S1-N4: “When the bell count is zero, no badge is shown.”

Last checked against build v26.40.7-7ffda69 on 10/5/2026.
